necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on reason code PR-204.
